title: BlueCove integration standup: spinup notes and blockers
content:
Purpose
Quick-cadence standup notes for the BlueCove Logistics integration — focused on Private deployment spinup, perf gating, and remaining blockers for first production mirror. Notes capture decisions, action owners, escalation paths. Informal — meant to be a living record between SE and ProServices during the ramp.

Attendees
- Maya Rodriguez (SE, notes/coord)
- Ethan Park (ProServices, infra lead)
- Priya Singh (SRE, observability)
- Noah Martinez (Customer Success, CSM)
- Hannah Li (Customer eng, BlueCove)
- (joined late) Jonah Wells (Security)

Context / objective
BlueCove is onboarding Redwood Private in their GCP project for sensitive logistics metadata. Goal: reach production mirror (read traffic only) by 2026-08-28, then phased write enablement after final security sign-off. Key constraints: VPC peering via Shared VPC, HSM-backed KMS, egress rules to telemetry limited, 1–2ms tail latency SLO for single-token on 1kB payloads for their chat assistant (internal ops).

Summary status (today)
- Infra: base VM pools provisioned, dedicated GPU nodes (A10G) requested and pending quota bump. (Ethan)
- Network: Shared VPC peering established, but packet drops observed on large batch transfers during soak test. (Priya/Hannah)
- Security & Compliance: KMS integration validated in staging; HSM cert rotation timeline TBD. (Jonah)
- Serving runtime: model artifact (gpt-medium-quant) uploaded; windowing and KV cache verified locally. However memory pressure observed when KV cache > 6GiB. (Maya)
- Observability: traces coming through; token-level cost logs missing for a small subset of routed requests (probable router tag mismatch). (Priya)
- Customer: BlueCove performed initial smoke flows and confirmed API key rotation process works. They want daily sync until mirror. (Noah/Hannah)

Accomplishments since last sync
- Completed baseline private control plane deployment in BlueCove staging project (PR 128 merged).
- Onboarded BlueCove engineers into the console with read/write as appropriate.
- Runbook draft created for KMS/HSM key binding and cert rotation (Confluence link above).
- First batch of perf/soak tests executed (2h window) with 95th p95 tokens < expected but p99 spikes present.

Current blockers (high priority)
1) GPU quota pending (GCP request ID pending) — blocks scale testing beyond 2 concurrent workers.
   - Impact: can't validate autoscaler + burst capacity.
   - Owner: Ethan Park
   - Target resolution: 2026-08-20 (EOD) — escalation path to account manager if not approved.

2) Network packet drops during 3rd-party S3-backed artifact replication (large payloads). Intermittent, appears when batching > 50MB.
   - Impact: cold-start artifact syncs fail ~1/40 in soak tests, causing retry storms and temporary token inflation.
   - Temporary mitigation: chunking artifacts to <32MB, apply exponential backoff in replication job.
   - Owner: Hannah Li + Ethan (network & infra)
   - Next step: packet capture during next run (Priya to coordinate) — due 2026-08-19.

3) KV cache memory pressure causing OOM on staging host when sequence windows are high (customer-specific workload has long context sessions).
   - Impact: restart loops in one pod type; risk of state loss if not preserved.
   - Owner: Maya Rodriguez
   - Mitigation: lower in-memory cache limit and enable prefix caching for common prompts; consider serialized remote KV store as fallback.
   - Task: implement soft cap and fallbacks by 2026-08-21.

4) Missing token-level cost markers on ~3% of requests routed through regional-fallback path.
   - Impact: billing attribution and cost dashboards inaccurate for early usage; affects contract metrics.
   - Owner: Priya Singh
   - Note: probable router tag mismatch between private control plane and hosted analytics endpoint.

Risks (non-blocking but to watch)
- HSM cert rotation timeline may push write-enable milestone beyond target date if external vendor SLA slips. (Security)
- Customer has a hard compliance review scheduled 2026-08-30; any major infra change after 2026-08-25 may trigger re-review.
- Observability retention: BlueCove requested 90-day token-level logs in Private; cost implication needs commercial signoff.

Decisions made
- Keep production mirror read-only until HSM rotation fully tested and SRE gives signoff.
- For immediate scale validation, we will use smaller artifact chunk sizes and re-run the soak for 4hrs on 2026-08-20.
- Enable autoscaler with conservative thresholds (scale-up threshold 70% GPU util) for initial burst tests.

Action items (owner / due)
- Ethan: follow up with GCP quota team and escalate to account manager if no response by 2026-08-19. (Due 2026-08-19)
- Priya: capture packet traces during next artifact sync and open a networking ticket (ENG-3491). (Due 2026-08-19)
- Maya: implement KV cache soft cap & prefix-caching fallback; add unit test to cover long session behaviour. (Due 2026-08-21)
- Hannah (customer): re-run artifact replication with smaller chunk size and report errors to SE on 2026-08-19. (Due 2026-08-19)
- Noah: prepare customer-facing status email with outlined mitigations and expected milestone dates; send 2026-08-19 morning. (Due 2026-08-19)
- Jonah: confirm HSM rotation window and vendor SLA; document required blackout windows in Confluence. (Due 2026-08-20)
- Priya + Maya: short post-mortem template for OOM restart event (if occurs) and runbook update. (Due 2026-08-22)

Open questions / unresolved
- Is BlueCove willing to accept 95-day observability retention (compromise) if we offer cost-sharing on storage? (action: Noah to clarify in sync)
- If HSM vendor misses rotation date, do we temporarily accept cloud KMS for parity testing (non-prod only)? Security needs scoring.
- Would BlueCove prefer more aggressive autoscaler thresholds once mirror is stable? (defer to performance signoff)

Notes to self / meeting prep for next sync
- Bring a short demo of prefix-caching behavior showing memory delta before/after (Maya)
- Have PR 128 readiness checklist (Ethan) — include post-merge validation steps
- Prepare list of impacted customer routes for router-tag fix (Priya)

Next sync cadence
- Daily brief standup at 09:30 PT through mirror milestone (calendar invites maintained by Noah).
- Weekly technical retrospective every Friday (deep dive) starting 2026-08-21.

Appendix: quick logs / snippets (copied from staging)
- Error sample: replica-sync error: "packet write: connection reset by peer" — timestamps cluster around 16:13–16:17 PST (2026-08-17).
- OOM trace snippet: runtime panic: kv_cache: mem_alloc failed, attempted 6.4GiB allocation, host mem avail 7GiB — trace attached to ENG-3491.

Conversions / follow-ups after this note
- Convert runbook draft into customer-facing checklist and record in Confluence space /display/SE/BlueCove+Onramp+Runbook (Noah + Maya).
- If quotas aren't satisfied by 2026-08-19, prepare contingency plan to run limited-scale soak on alternative region (us-west2 -> us-central1).

End of notes.

Quick revision log
- 2026-08-18: initial capture (Maya)
- 2026-08-19: added network packet trace task (Priya)
- 2026-08-20: updated quota escalation status (Ethan)
- 2026-08-23: merged PR link and minor wording tweaks (Maya)

-- maya
